description:
Brand Introduction:

Shokz is a leading brand in audio technology, specializing in bone conduction headphones designed to cater to athletes, fitness enthusiasts, and professionals. With the innovative bone conduction technology, Shokz allows users to enjoy high-quality sound while staying aware of their surroundings. This makes them an ideal choice for active individuals, whether in sports, fitness, or remote work environments.

Shokz offers a wide range of earphones designed specifically for running, swimming and meetings, each engineered to meet the needs of its unique customer base. With a commitment to quality, comfort, and innovation, Shokz has become a trusted brand for individuals who demand both performance and safety in their audio products.

1-[Product Description]

Shokz offers a series of bone conduction headphones designed for various activities, ensuring users can enjoy music or make calls while staying connected to their environment. Bone conduction headphones work by transmitting sound vibrations through the bones of the skull, bypassing the eardrums, which allows users to hear audio while maintaining awareness of their surroundings — perfect for athletes or professionals who need situational awareness.

Product Range:

1.For Running & Sports:

  • OpenRun: Lightweight, sweatproof, and designed for comfort, OpenRun provides runners with the freedom to hear music while being fully aware of their surroundings.
  • OpenRun Pro 2: The latest model with advanced features, including improved Bluetooth connectivity, extended battery life, and even better sound quality for professional runners and athletes.

2.For Lfie & Comfort:

  • OpenFit: True wireless open-ear earbuds designed for all-day comfort. With an innovative open-ear design and flexible earhooks, these earbuds provide a natural, immersive listening experience while keeping you connected to your surroundings. Perfect for those who want premium sound quality without compromising awareness.
  • OpenFit Air: A lightweight and ultra-comfortable open-ear alternative for everyday use. Featuring an ergonomic design and featherlight fit, OpenFit Air delivers crystal-clear audio while allowing you to stay aware of your environment. Ideal for active lifestyles and long-wearing comfort.

3.For Swimming:

  • OpenSwim: Waterproof headphones designed specifically for swimmers. With no traditional wires, these headphones are ideal for underwater listening, making them perfect for swimmers who want to enjoy their favorite music or podcasts while in the pool.
  • OpenSwim Pro: The enhanced version of the OpenSwim, offering superior sound quality and added durability for long-term underwater use.

4.For Meetings & Work:

  • OpenComm: Designed for professionals who need to attend virtual meetings, OpenComm includes a noise-canceling boom microphone and is perfect for clear communication during conference calls or Zoom meetings.
  • OpenComm 2: The upgraded version of OpenComm, featuring better sound quality, a more flexible microphone, and enhanced comfort for all-day use.

2-[Unique Selling Point]

The Unique Selling Point (USP) of Shokz headphones lies in bone conduction technology, which provides a unique combination of high-quality sound and environmental awareness.

Key features include:

  • Situational Awareness: Unlike traditional headphones, Shokz leaves the ear canals open, allowing users to hear surrounding sounds like traffic, people, or hazards while listening to music or taking calls — ideal for athletes and professionals alike.
  • Comfort & Safety: Shokz headphones are designed to be comfortable for extended use, with lightweight materials and ergonomic designs that make them perfect for long workouts or work meetings.
  • Durability & Waterproofing: Many models are sweatproof and waterproof, making them resistant to extreme conditions, from intense workouts to swimming in the pool.
  • Clear Communication: The inclusion of noise-canceling microphones (on models like OpenComm) ensures that users can make clear calls or participate in virtual meetings without external distractions.

Shokz headphones are not only functional but also highly adaptable to different environments, allowing athletes, remote workers, and professionals to enjoy high-quality sound while staying safe and aware.

3-[Payment Terms]

To encourage and reward affiliates, it’s important to have clear payment terms in place. Here’s a suggested structure:

  • Commission Rate: Affiliates earn a percentage of the sale made through their referral link. The standard commission rate generally starts at 5% of the sale price, depending on the product category or affiliate’s performance.
  • Payment Method: Affiliates will be paid via PayPal.
  • Payment Frequency:  Monthly payments are common in affiliate programs.
  • Cookie Duration: Typically, a cookie duration of 30 days means that if someone clicks on an affiliate’s link, they’ll be credited with the sale even if the customer purchases within the next 30 days.
  • Payment Terms Example: “Affiliates are paid monthly via PayPal for commissions. Payments are made on the 30th of every month, for sales made during the previous month.”

4-[Other Information]

Affiliate Tools and Resources:

Provide your affiliates with the following marketing materials to help them promote your products effectively:

  • Affiliate Link Generator: A tool for affiliates to generate their unique referral links.
  • Banners and Ads: Professional banners, ads, and images they can place on their website or blog.
  • Discount Codes: Exclusive discount codes they can offer to their audience, increasing the likelihood of conversions.
  • Email Templates: Pre-written email marketing templates that affiliates can send to their subscribers, helping them promote Shokz products in an engaging way.
  • Product Reviews & Testimonials: Encourage affiliates to use product samples or provide testimonials and reviews to build trust with their audience.

Tracking and Reporting:

  • Real-Time Tracking: Affiliates should have access to a dashboard where they can view real-time data on their clicks, conversions, and earnings.
  • Reports: Affiliates should receive monthly or weekly reports with key metrics like clicks, conversions, and commissions to help them optimize their marketing strategies.

Support & Communication:

  • Provide a dedicated support team for affiliates who have questions or need assistance.
  • Offer regular communication, whether it’s through a newsletter, email, or an affiliate Facebook group, to keep affiliates updated on new products, promotions, and tips for driving sales.

Brand Guidelines:

  • Provide clear brand guidelines regarding how affiliates should represent Shokz. This includes logo usage, tone of messaging, and any rules around paid advertising (e.g., no bidding on Shokz-branded keywords in Google Ads).

Terms and conditions

Welcome to Shokz.uk! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as the merchant (“we”, “merchant” or “Shokz”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, ... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and payment

3.1 Product prices. You shall carry out the promotion according to the Product prices of the Shokz official store {Shokz.uk}.

3.2 Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost, ...).

Commission calculation: The commission shall be equal to the final price of the headphones multiplied by the commission percentage. Different order amounts correspond to different commission rates, the higher the amount of the referred order, the higher the commission you will receive. Handling fees charged by banks or Paypal will be deducted from your final commission;

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details in Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. The Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives the merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

3.3 Cheating: If Shokz determines that you have conducted illegal promotion, Shokz shall have the right to refuse to pay the commission of the withdrawal month and/or the month when violation takes place. If Shokz has already paid the commission, you shall return the full amount of commission back to Shokz. If you have any objection about the result, you shall provide evidence to prove that your promotion behavior complies with this Agreement, including website address of promotion links on the location of the websites and web page screenshots, etc. Shokz reserves the right to make decisions independently on the evidence.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion medias such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share onto affiliate channels.

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is stated in the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: hisquad@shokz.com.

8. Intellectual Property Rights

All promotion medias provided to you through the uppromote.com are owned by Shokz and are protected by copyright laws, trademark laws and all other intellectual property rights and unfair competition laws in different countries. Shokz authorizes you to use promotion materials subject to the following conditions: (1) You agree not to copy, modify, republish, upload, post, transmit or distribute any promotion medias without Shokz prior consent; All promotion medias are the property of Shokz and may be updated at any time; (2) You agree to use these promotion medias for Affiliate Program use only and not for any other unauthorized commercial or illegal use; (3) You agree not to remove any copyright, trademark, or other proprietary notices that have been placed on the promotion materials.

Shokz reserve the right to take legal measures if the promotion medias are used for any other unauthorized commercial or illegal use.

9. Disclaimer

9.1 Creative advertisements made by yourself on online channels are your personal behavior which has nothing to do with Shokz. If the pictures, words, or music you used in the advertisements that is not provided by Shokz infringe upon any third party’s intellectual properties, you shall bear all the responsibilities for infringement and any other damages.

9.2 If any adverse effect is caused to Shokz, including but not limited to damaging Shokz's reputation or brand images, bringing any third party's tort complaints and/or litigation disputes, disclosing any information of Shokz that has not been publicized, due to your fault, you shall bear the liability to compensate.

10. Amendment and Termination of the Agreement

10.1 Shokz may at any time modify this Agreement (including adjustment of the commission percentage) at any time as the business evolves and post the modification on Shokz Affiliate Program sites (https://uk.shokz.com/pages/affiliate-program) or notify you by any other means; you shall check it in a timely manner. If you continue to use the Shokz Affiliate Program service, it shall be deemed that you consent to the modification of this Agreement.

10.2 During the effective period of this Agreement, if any Party fails to correct the following material breach after 3 days of its occurrence, the other Party shall be entitled to notify the breaching Party in writing to terminate this Agreement and claim relevant losses:

  10.2.1 making false promises or providing false information in relation to this promotion;

  10.2.2 you violating this Agreement by disrupting the market with unauthorized sales at low prices;

  10.2.3 any delay of payment under this Agreement by any Party.

 Lastly, we would like to emphasize that we do not recognize or accept any abnormal promotional behavior that results in issues such as unauthorized discount code leakage. Activities such as order brushing (fake orders) are strictly prohibited. We reserve the right to take appropriate actions in response to such violations, including but not limited to withholding commissions for invalid orders and terminating the partnership.
